title: Alien Sorceress in Orb
description: A green-skinned alien with intricate black patterned hair and large black eyes stands inside a transparent glowing sphere. She wears ornate golden robes with pink and blue patterns while manipulating purple and blue electrical energy with both hands, surrounded by floating planets against a cosmic nebula background.
prompt: A green-skinned female alien with elaborate black swirling patterned hair and large glossy black eyes, wearing ornate golden robes with pink and blue details, stands inside a large transparent energy sphere crackling with bright purple and blue lightning. She manipulates electrical energy with her hands, with several detailed planets and moons floating around her inside the orb, set against a dark space background with purple nebulae and lightning.
